content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) includes GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, this stack is ideal for creators who want a simple, easy-to-deploy solution, while the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) adds Cloudflare Pages and Supabase to provide a more comprehensive commerce infrastructure, complete with SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations and end-to-end testing, both stacks are designed to give digital creators full control over their store infrastructure, without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in countries where conventional payment processors are unavailable or severely restricted, such as Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, the Philippines, and others, by providing a self-hosted, self-managed solution, creators can avoid the risk of account suspension or account freeze, and ensure that their business remains operational, regardless of the restrictions imposed by payment processors.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments, the payment processor integrated into COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, offers lightning-fast payment processing, with transaction fees as low as $0.10 per transaction, on popular networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON, this is significantly lower than the fees charged by conventional payment processors, which can range from 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction to as high as 5% per transaction, COREMERCH's solution also eliminates the risk of payment delays or cancellations, which can be a major headache for digital creators.
Don't rely on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad to manage your store infrastructure, instead, choose a sovereign commerce infrastructure solution that gives you complete control and flexibility.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, digital creators have complete control over their store infrastructure, including the customer list, order history, product files, and wallet addresses, this means that creators can automate their business, set up automatic delivery of digital products, and manage their customers' data, all without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, which can freeze or suspend accounts at any time.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

COREMERCH offers a range of sovereign commerce infrastructure options, including the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, instant download, and worth $348 separately, the right choice depends on the specific needs of the digital creator, whether it's a simple, easy-to-deploy solution or a more comprehensive commerce infrastructure, both options provide the flexibility and control that digital creators need to succeed.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

What is the most important thing to consider when choosing a sovereign commerce infrastructure solution? The most important thing to consider is the level of control and flexibility that the solution provides, as well as the ability to automate business processes and manage customer data, without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, COREMERCH's solution provides all of these benefits, and more, making it the ideal choice for digital creators in countries where conventional payment processors are unavailable or severely restricted.
Automate your business and manage customer data with COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, without relying on conventional payment processors.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure with COREMERCH, follow these concrete steps: 1. Choose the right stack, Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197), based on your specific needs, 2. Deploy the stack on GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, or Google Apps Script, 3. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, 4. Set up automatic delivery of digital products using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, 5. Configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC settings for email delivery and security, 6. Test the infrastructure end-to-end to ensure seamless payment processing and delivery.
